task.description:
Implement lib/letflow/design/iss0343-backfill-missing-schema-tolerance.md (approved design, passed CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR after 1 rework) per WF-03 Step 3. Claim this handoff by setting status to IN_PROGRESS only.

1. Verify branch: git branch --show-current must equal feature/WF03-ISS0343-20260826.
2. Implement the design's §2.1/§2.2/§2.3/§3 in lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex (new :tenant_schema_missing error tuple, rescue_missing_schema/1 helper narrowly matching %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table}}, applied at the three named call sites) and lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex (new case clause treating :tenant_schema_missing as a skip). CONFIRM THE EXACT POSTGREX ATOM: before relying on :undefined_table, verify empirically (e.g. iex -S mix, trigger a real undefined-table error against a Postgrex connection, inspect the error struct) or by grepping how existing code in this codebase already matches Postgrex error codes -- the design flagged this as unconfirmed.
3. mix compile --warnings-as-errors -- fix and retry if FAIL.
4. mix format --check-formatted.
5. Run the existing test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs and test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs suites to confirm no regression, quote real output.
6. Complete the handoff with artifacts_out: ["lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex", "lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex"], next_action: "Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER".
7. Commit on feature/WF03-ISS0343-20260826 and push.
acceptance_criteria: the exact Postgrex error atom for SQLSTATE 42P01 (undefined_table) is confirmed empirically or by codebase precedent, not assumed
register_type/2 and get_type/2 return {:error, :tenant_schema_missing} when the schema is concurrently missing, distinct from {:error, :tenant_not_provisioned}
Backfill.run/1 treats :tenant_schema_missing as a skip (increments :skipped), does not crash the reduce_while loop
mix compile --warnings-as-errors exits 0, real output quoted
existing registry_test.exs and backfill_test.exs suites still pass unchanged, real output quoted
